name: waypoint
description: Zero-telemetry, local-first spatial canvas browser built on native Electron WebContentsViews
author: Ronald Malouin

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.smoke: npm run build && D=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wp-smoke.XXXXXX") && WAYPOINT_SMOKE=1 WAYPOINT_CONFIG_DIR="$D/config" electron . --smoke --user-data-dir="$D/user-data"; s=$?; if [ $s -eq 0 ]; then rm -rf "$D"; fi; exit $s
